description: Source code for SQL store operations related to boards in the focalboard project, including CRUD, search, history, and membership management.

methods.name: boardFields
methods.description: Returns a list of column names for board queries, optionally prefixed with a table alias.

methods.name: boardHistoryFields
methods.description: Returns a list of column names for board history queries.

methods.name: boardMembersFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of BoardMember objects.

methods.name: boardsFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of Board objects.

methods.name: boardMemberHistoryEntriesFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of BoardMemberHistoryEntry objects, parsing timestamps accordingly.

methods.name: getBoardByCondition
methods.description: Fetches a single board matching specified conditions.

methods.name: getBoardsByCondition
methods.description: Fetches multiple boards matching specified conditions.

methods.name: getBoardsFieldsByCondition
methods.description: Fetches boards with specific fields and conditions.

methods.name: getBoard
methods.description: Retrieves a board by its ID.

methods.name: getBoardsForUserAndTeam
methods.description: Retrieves boards for a user within a team, with option to include public boards.

methods.name: getBoardsInTeamByIds
methods.description: Retrieves boards by IDs within a specific team.

methods.name: insertBoard
methods.description: Inserts or updates a board record, including history logging.

methods.name: patchBoard
methods.description: Applies a patch to an existing board and re-inserts it.

methods.name: deleteBoard
methods.description: Deletes a board and its children, with history logging.

methods.name: deleteBoardAndChildren
methods.description: Deletes a board, optionally keeping children, with history logging.

methods.name: insertBoardWithAdmin
methods.description: Inserts a new board and assigns an admin member.

methods.name: saveMember
methods.description: Creates or updates a board member, logging history.

methods.name: deleteMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a board and logs the action.

methods.name: getMemberForBoard
methods.description: Retrieves a specific member of a board.

methods.name: getMembersForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all boards a user is a member of.

methods.name: getMembersForBoard
methods.description: Retrieves all members of a specific board.

methods.name: searchBoardsForUser
methods.description: Searches for boards accessible to a user, filtering by term and field.

methods.name: searchBoardsForUserInTeam
methods.description: Searches for boards within a team accessible to a user, filtering by term.

methods.name: getBoardHistory
methods.description: Retrieves history entries for a board with optional time filtering.

methods.name: undeleteBoard
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted board from history.

methods.name: getBoardMemberHistory
methods.description: Retrieves history of actions performed on a board member.
